biotools.summary: GermVarX is a modular, automated workflow designed for joint germline variant discovery and exploration in large whole-exome sequencing (WES) cohorts. It performs scalable variant calling, quality control, and functional annotation using established tools like GATK and DeepVariant.
biotools.name: GermVarX
